company.name: Bevi
company.shortDescription: Bevi develops a smart water dispenser that customizes flavored and sparkling beverages on demand.
company.description: Bevi develops a smart water dispenser that provides customizable flavors made from filtered tap water and natural ingredients. Bevi aims to eliminate waste from the production, shipping, and disposing of bottled beverages. Bevi envisions a future where a smarter platform (powered by the municipal water supply) transforms how beverages are delivered.

productsAndServices.description: A freestanding, bottleless smart water dispenser that provides filtered still, sparkling, ambient, and hot water with customizable flavors, carbonation, and functional enhancements.
productsAndServices.name: The Standup 2.0

productsAndServices.description: A compact, bottleless water dispenser for commercial spaces that provides filtered still, sparkling, ambient, and hot water with customizable flavors and enhancements.
productsAndServices.name: The Countertop

productsAndServices.description: Natural flavor concentrates and functional beverage additions used with Bevi dispensers to create customized still or sparkling drinks with adjustable flavor strength.
productsAndServices.name: Flavors & Enhancements

productsAndServices.description: A temporary dispenser rental service that provides a Bevi machine, delivery, installation, and event support for corporate gatherings and other short-term commercial uses.
productsAndServices.name: Bevi Machine Rental

productsAndServices.description: Commercial deployment and support services for Bevi dispensers, including installation, consumable replenishment, filter replacement, monitoring, diagnostics, and ongoing maintenance.
productsAndServices.name: Bevi Installation, Maintenance & Service

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series D round raised $70,000,000, or 53.73% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $190,000, representing 0.15% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,829,436 to $559,225,203, a 305.68x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 56 (-5 over 90 days) and market heat at 56 (-8).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Liquid Death, Hint, Aquabeve.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
